title: Force-stop: simulation does not restart by itself
observed: No process, foreground service, notification, or wake lock for 127 s (0.4.7) and 67 s (0.4.8)

title: Force-stop: test providers removed without reopening the app
expected: Providers removed and no stale mock fix offered
observed: 3 providers stayed for 127 s (0.4.7) and 67 s (0.4.8). Last known on gps, fused, and network stayed the final mock fix, flagged as mock and showing 8.333 m/s; the observer read it 6 times. Android gives no callback at force-stop, so this is the known limitation

title: Force-stop: no fresh mock fixes
expected: No fix newer than the force-stop
observed: Newest mock fix 0.9 s before force-stop; none newer in Android records; observer mock callbacks stayed at 39 for 127 s, and at 34 for 67 s on 0.4.8

title: Reopening RouteMock removes the providers
observed: All 3 removed about 1.1 s after the launch command, on 0.4.7 and 0.4.8; last known cleared to none; a new observer session saw 0 mock callbacks and real fixes again

title: Playback stays stopped after reopening
expected: No service or new mock fixes
observed: No service, notification, or provider for 139 s (0.4.7) and 51 s (0.4.8). A later Start was refused until the saved route was loaded again

title: Normal Stop, for comparison
observed: 0 providers by the first sample 7 s after notification Stop; last known not mock-flagged; 0 new mock callbacks and 57 real fixes in 60 s

title: Recovery notice seen on reopening (0.4.8)
expected: Notice shown where the app opens
observed: 0.4.8 opened on Simulation with the notice that the simulation ended without Stop and the providers were removed. On 0.4.7 it opened on Map, with the notice only on Simulation

title: Consent withdrawal
observed: Withdraw all left every scope WITHDRAWN and four unticked boxes; test marker removed
